_comment: DEMO / FALLBACK rules only — non-canonical. Real games get their tier tables and stats from World-Forge data (per-entity damage_tiers / bestiary tier_tables). These values are used only when an entity specifies nothing of its own, so the kit stays runnable standalone for quick testing. The parser LLM only classifies a damage_tier; the server maps the tier to dice and rolls it here.
_safeguards_comment: Deterministic guards that limit the blast radius of an LLM tier mislabel. See rpg-engine-kit/schema/README.md (Reliability) for the rationale.

governor._comment: Caps a single hit's damage as a fraction of the target's maxhp, so a misclassified 'heavy/critical' can't one-shot. 'critical' is exempt by design (crits are meant to be lethal). Set enabled:false to disable.
